body:
Owner greenlit the AI Connections layer (design brief in the 2026-09-18 chat;
assessment + parked design P-2026-09-18-1). Intended change: turn the provider
system from product-code rows into user-configurable connections.

Scope (paths below): a connections store seeded from PROVIDER_CONFIGS with
user records in settings.json; get_adapter() and the OpenAI-compatible adapter
resolve a connection record instead of a registry-only key; settings API gains
connection CRUD + a test/probe endpoint; the Settings modal's provider picker
becomes an AI Connections manager (add/edit/test/enable/fallback/capabilities).

Why safe: disjoint from the live memory-routing work on the main tree (that
scope is backend/src/core/memory_intent.py, memory_tool.py, agent_runtime.py,
tests/core/test_memory_*.py — none claimed here). All product edits happen in
my own worktree (LocalMind-nia-s015, branch collab/S015/nia-s015), never the
main checkout. Preset ids stay the provider names, so every existing
adapter/model/env-var workflow keeps working; new connections get their own
ids and are opt-in.
